<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1098
Claimant:
Jasmin Kelly
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
06/27/2025
The claimant reported a low-speed head-on collision this morning and stated that a shoulder injury began at the
scene. The claim was opened and the claimant confirmed they are not represented by an attorney.
07/29/2025
Called the claimant to walk through the sequence of events. The account given matched the first report, and the
claimant said they had been stopped at a light before the other vehicle struck the front of their car.
08/05/2025
Spoke with the other driver, who described the same impact and agreed on the direction each vehicle was traveling.
Their statement lines up with the claimant's account in every major point.
08/10/2025
Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant was seated in the driver's position at the time of the collision.
Officer notes match the scene description given by both parties.
08/11/2025
Received the scene photographs and two witness statements. Both witnesses describe the same low-speed contact
and place the claimnat inside the vehicle when it happened.
08/15/2025
Inspected the vehicle damage at the repair facility. The crush pattern and the location of the front-end damage are
consistent with the impact described, and no prior damage to the vehicle is on record.
09/06/2025
Checked coverage records. The driver is listed on the policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred
before coverage began.
09/11/2025
The claimant reported a shoulder injury and was seen at urgent care the same day. The clinician's notes describe
pain and limited movement, which fits the type of force involved in a collsiion like this one.
09/24/2025
Asked the claimant about prior medical history to the same area. The claimant recalled a minor strain several years
ago and confirmed it healed fully with no lasting problems. Records reviewed so far support that account.
11/06/2025
The claimant has since added a few small details about the moment of impact, such as the sound and the seat
position. The core account has not changed, and the additions do not conflict with the scene evidence.
12/04/2025
Treatment has followed a typical course, with physical therapy sessions scheduled and then spaced out as the
claimant reported steady improvement. Recent notes show the shoulder is now close to its pre-accident range of
movement.
01/02/2026
Based on the damage pattern, the injury type, and the consistent statements from all parties, the claim is progressing
normally. Next step is to finalize the treatment summary and confirm the remaining records before closing the file.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
